notes.title: So Many Wishlists!
notes.content: [p]Hey![/p][p][/p][p]We're humbled that so many of you have shown an interest over the course of Next Fest! [/p][p][/p][p]We've finalised our roadmap and we're now working towards a V1 release.[/p][p][/p][p]You can reach out to us on [url="https://www.existerror.com" buttoncolor="#eefb37"]our website[/url] where you will find links to our social media pages and the development Discord. Come and say hi![/p][p][/p][p]We're really excited to show you the next steps and what we're working on. It's going to be bolder, bigger, badder, bloodier and other words that start with B that would suggest this might just be the best game you've ever played.[/p][p][/p][p]Key points:[/p][list][*][p]All levels artwork, puzzles and ambience complete.[/p][/*][*][p]Refinements to UI and UX experience[/p][/*][*][p]All audio refined and created in 3d space for ultimate [i]immurshun[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Re-branding on some of the key game artwork to really capture the tone of the game[/p][/*][*][p]New features such as a Beastiary, advanced statistics and online leaderboards[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks[/p][p]- Jamie & Frank[/p][p][/p][p]and remember, Don't Forget to Smile.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Wishlist already? Jump into the comments and tell us what feature you’re most hyped about![/i][/p]

notes.title: State of the Game & Next Fest
notes.content: [p][b]Hello and welcome![/b][/p][p][/p][p]If you’re here because of Next Fest, thank you for stopping by - we’re glad to have you! We’re excited to announce that our demo is complete and ready to play, right on schedule for the festival.[/p][p][/p][p]The community around the demo is still small - quiet, even - but that’s okay. On the private playtesting side, things are [b]very active.[/b] We’re engaging in thoughtful discussions about the game’s direction, what’s working well, and where improvements are needed. This [b]valuable feedback[/b] is helping shape the project [b]every day.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This game is the passion project of two dedicated developers balancing family, work, and life commitments. We are fully committed to creating an experience that players [b]genuinely enjoy[/b]. There’s no intention to rush, cut corners, or cash in on hype. [b]Our goal is a polished, meaningful game you’ll want to play and talk about.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]All artwork, music and gameplay is created from scratch and tailored entirely towards sticking a [b]middle[/b] [b]finger[/b] to the man.[/p][p][/p][p]We invite you to join us on this journey. Whether you want to share [b]feedback[/b], stay [b]updated[/b], or just say hello, you’ll find [b]links[/b] on the [b]store page[/b] and the corner of the main menu.[/p][p][/p][p]Your involvement and support mean a lot to us.[/p][p][/p][p]On our [b]discord[/b] we have open chats for slogans and signage in the game (if you want to try your hand at some corporate satire and [b]get yourself in the game[/b]), and the opportunity to [b]take part in the playtest branch[/b] - which is [b]far more developed[/b] than the demo![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of the community. We’re just getting started.[/p][p][/p][p](Oh, and the demo is staying up indefinitely)[/p][p][/p][p][i]— Jamie & Frankie[/i][/p]
